**Core issue:** The crate is a textbook example of the primitive obsession anti-pattern. `ShardWorkflow` uses `String` for status and two independent `bool` flags instead of a single typestate enum. This makes illegal states (sent without validated, double-sent, arbitrary status strings) fully representable by the type system.
